title: West Elm's Incredibly Durable Chip & Dip Tray Will Be the Star of Your Next Party - NewsBreak
text:
By Fred Hernandez ,
2 hours ago
Men’s Journal aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission. Prices are accurate and items in stock at time of publishing.
Few things disappear faster at a party than chips and dip . West Elm’s Modern Melamine Chip & Dip Tray makes serving those crowd favorites easy without sacrificing style. At $30.99 (marked down from $49.50), it’s affordable, practical, and built to last.
Designed by Aaron Probyn, the tray is made of lightweight melamine that’s tough enough for everyday use. It’s dishwasher safe and outdoor-friendly, so you don’t have to think twice about where you use it. Instead of being one of those serving pieces you pull out once a year, this one works just as well for casual nights at home as it does for entertaining a full crowd.

Modern Melamine Chip & Dip Tray, $30.99 (Was $49.50) at West Elm Modern Melamine Chip & Dip Tray This tray is built for function first. At 13-inches across, it gives you plenty of space for chips, crackers, or sliced vegetables , while the built-in 20-ounce dip bowl in the center holds enough guac or salsa to keep the crowd happy.
The all-in-one design means no juggling separate bowls or worrying about dishes sliding around the table. It’s large enough to handle party spreads but still light enough to carry with one hand if you’re making the rounds.
The look is just as considered as the build. A matte exterior contrasts with a smooth, glossy interior, giving it a modern finish that feels right at home on any table. Because it’s melamine, it has the sturdiness of heavier serveware without the risk of chips or cracks.
Compared to flimsy plastic trays, this feels like a major upgrade—sleek enough to impress guests but durable enough for everyday use. As part of West Elm’s Kaloh Collection, it’s designed to be stylish and practical without taking up half your cupboard.
Related: IKEA’s $10 Picnic Set Is the Tailgate Gear You Didn’t Know You Needed
More Than Just Chips and Dip Chips and dip are the obvious move, but this tray is a lot more versatile than the name suggests. Fill it with shrimp cocktail and cocktail sauce in the center, or pile it high with veggies and hummus.
For dessert, swap in cookies, fruit, or pretzels with chocolate fondue or caramel dip. The generous size and built-in bowl make it easy to pull off a polished spread without extra effort.
Think game-day nachos, summer cookouts, or even a holiday dessert bar. Instead of scrambling for mismatched bowls, one tray handles it all, keeping the table neat and the food easy to grab.
The clean white finish blends with almost any tableware, so it won’t look out of place whether you’re hosting a backyard BBQ or a holiday dinner. However you use it, the tray makes serving feel effortless—and that’s exactly what you want when you’re the one hosting.
